title: Sources
text: The data was taken from a dataset published by AAA and was added to/adjusted by me, Copilot AI, Chat GPT, and Claude AI. Since there was little data for multiple graphs, I decided to add a comparison of different EVs and their gas counterparts to further explore the connections and differences between prices in different states.

title: About
text:
My name is Ayush Chandra and I am in 9th grade at Sharon High School. You find my work on GitHub or contact me at chandra.ayush2021@gmail.com.
My project is about the average cost of paying for gas versus paying for charging over a 3 year period in the US. It also includes comparisons between different EVs and their gas counterparts. The code and data are available at the Github Repo.
This site was created for Kane’s Data Science Bootcamp.

title: EV Charging vs Gas Costs Over 3 Years Graphic
text: Have you ever wondered whether an EV or a gas car would be better for you? I’ve been exploring the best states to buy an EV in, and comparing different EVs with their gas counterparts using a data set from AAA. Today, I have compiled the data into multiple interactive graphs that lets you visualize EV costs over a span of 3 years compared to gas costs over the same time frame. I also made multiple other graphs and tables that demonstrate the key takeaways and comparisons of specific cars. I have found that the best EV model compared to its gas counterpart is the Honda Prologue, and the best states to buy an EV in are Washington and California. Feel free to look around and enjoy the website!
